authority: 01 Developer Build Specification §4, edition 2.0; RA01 v1.0
notes: Money is integer pence. IDs are immutable text, never row numbers. TEXT columns must be Format > Number > Plain text in Sheets. Columns ending _at are UTC timestamps. Columns ending _pence are integer pence. Nullable means unknown/not yet supplied, not zero or No. 12 Sep 2026: PersonSkills, PersonAvailability, Teams, TeamMembers added for resource planning (runbook §A); additive, provision missing tabs only.

s01_placeholder_replacement.note: The S01_Setup placeholder column in DEV/TEST Sheets is replaced when S02 table headers are created. Each table becomes a separate sheet tab. The S01_Setup column can be deleted from the default Sheet1 tab after all table tabs exist.
s01_placeholder_replacement.procedure: 1. Create one sheet tab per table in this schema. 2. Populate column headers from the columns array. 3. Delete the S01_Setup placeholder column from the original tab. 4. The AppSheet app source must be updated to point to the new table tabs.
